guide.cobblemonranger.styler.body:
The Capture Styler is a Ranger's main tool. Its durability bar is its energy: every hit a Pokémon lands on your capture line drains some. An empty styler can't start a capture, but it never breaks.

Energy comes back by 1 every %1$s seconds while you carry the styler. You can also repair it with redstone at an anvil, or recharge it at a Ranger HQ Terminal once every %2$s minutes.

Captures, missions and new Browser entries give the styler XP. Each styler level adds a little energy, line length and loop power, and raises the highest level of Pokémon you can capture. Each level takes more XP than the last.

Craft a styler with a dye to change its colour.
guide.cobblemonranger.capturing.body:
Right-click a wild Pokémon with your styler to start a capture. You need a free slot in your party.

Hold the mouse button and draw loops around the Pokémon. Every closed loop fills its friendship gauge, and the capture succeeds when the gauge is full. The gauge slowly drains if you stop looping.

The Pokémon fights back. If one of its attacks touches your line, the line breaks and the styler loses energy. Run out of energy and the capture fails.

A level 1 styler can capture Pokémon up to level %1$s, and each styler level raises that by %2$s.

Press Escape to give up a capture.
guide.cobblemonranger.browser.body:
The Browser tab lists every species you have befriended with a styler. Hover over one to see how often you befriended it. A gold α marks a species you befriended as an Alpha.

The first time you befriend a species, your styler gets %1$s XP. Milestones from %2$s up to %3$s different species earn Ranger points.

Open this screen any time by right-clicking the air with your styler, or set a key for it in Controls.
guide.cobblemonranger.friends.body:
A Pokémon you capture becomes a friend. It joins your party for a while so it can help you, but it isn't yours to keep.

A friend goes home after the next battle it is around for, or as soon as it helps with a Poké Assist or a field move.

To let a friend go early, sneak and right-click it with the styler. Sneak and right-click the air to release all of them. Friends can't be kept in the PC or traded.
guide.cobblemonranger.assists.body:
During a capture, the friends and Partner in your party appear as Poké Assist buttons. Calling one gives an effect based on that Pokémon's primary type. Fire traps the wild Pokémon in a ring of flames, Water blows bubbles, Electric recharges your styler, and every other type does something of its own.

Effects that act on the wild Pokémon follow type matchups. They are stronger when super effective, and do nothing against a type that is immune.

A friend goes home after lending its assist. Your Partner stays, but its assist needs %1$s loops to charge, carried over between captures.
guide.cobblemonranger.partner.body:
Your Partner Pokémon is a lasting companion from your own team. Send out one of your Pokémon and right-click it with the styler to make it your Partner.

Your Partner helps with field moves without leaving. Each use costs %1$s styler energy, and it rests for %2$s seconds afterwards.

In captures it has its own, stronger Poké Assist.
guide.cobblemonranger.field_moves.body:
Friends and your Partner can clear obstacles in the world. Right-click the obstacle with your styler, and a Pokémon in your party that can help will do it.

Cut (Grass, Bug, Steel or Dark): leaves, vines, webs and tall grass, or a whole tree when used on a log.
Rock Smash (Fighting, Rock, Ground or Steel): cobblestone, cracked bricks, sandstone and gravel.
Soak (Water or Ice): puts out fire, and turns lava into obsidian or cobblestone.
Surf (Water): rides across water. Right-click the water.

A Pokémon that knows the move itself can help whatever its type. A friend goes home after helping, but your Partner stays.
guide.cobblemonranger.missions.body:
Rangers are villagers who work at a Ranger HQ, found in villages. Talk to one to get a mission: befriend certain Pokémon, use field moves or assists, battle with friends, or deliver items.

Finishing a mission gives emeralds, styler XP and Ranger points. Ranger points raise your Ranger rank, which unlocks harder missions and Ranger Signs.

After handing in a mission, you wait %1$s minutes before any Ranger offers another.
guide.cobblemonranger.upgrades.body:
Modules upgrade your styler. Energy modules add energy, Line modules make the capture line longer, and Power modules make each loop fill the gauge faster.

Modules turn up in chests, and every Ranger HQ chest holds one or two. Missions sometimes give one as a bonus.

Install them at a Ranger HQ Terminal, which also shows your mission and can recharge your styler.
guide.cobblemonranger.signs.body:
Ranger Signs call legendary Pokémon for help. Press G while carrying a styler and draw a sign on the pad.

Each sign unlocks at a Ranger rank, and the list beside the pad shows the ones you know. Celebi grows plants, Suicune heals your party, Entei cooks dropped items, Raikou finds wild Pokémon, Latios flies you home and Rayquaza launches you skyward. Groudon, Kyogre, Cresselia and Darkrai change the weather or time.

Weather and time signs have long cooldowns: %1$s minutes for you, and %2$s minutes for everyone on the server.
